title: reslicer: beat reslicing
author: tonyrewin
description: Beat reslicing for the SLICE machine. On the RESLICER machine (FUNC + SRC, below SLICE) the GRID knob turns past 64 to the divisions of the beat: 1/1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 1/8T, 1/16 and down to 1/64T. The sample is then cut into slices one step of the pattern apart, at the project's tempo, measured from the sequencer's own clock: the slices keep their place when the tempo changes, and a pitched sample's slices are a beat long as played. Nothing is stored, no sample is analysed and no memory is taken: the window function the render already calls each block does the arithmetic. The stock SLICE machine is left as it is.
